card.name: Colon inside clock times in timestamps
card.fires_on: The colon between hour and minutes in a time of day, such as 11:06 AM or 15:58:25. It appears in forum post, comment and email-archive timestamps.

modes.label: Forum and comment times
modes.description: Colon in a 12-hour time with am or pm after a posting date.

modes.label: Email and log times
modes.description: Colon in a 24-hour time within a date line or log header.
modes.example: Inheritance from builtin list and override of methods. fredrik at pythonware.com Mon Nov 27 15<<:>>58:25 CET 2

card.plain: It fires on the colon that splits hours from minutes in a posted date and time stamp.
